title: [finding] metadata-admin `CodeWidget` shows a stored expression envelope as `[object Object]`, and its first edit writes a bare string over the envelope
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**, finding class **(a)**. `reach:` is a named real producer, measured below. Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01ARcDurZ5j34RdqsGgc4jgH`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18917) from the review of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20428 (#19332 flight G1b). The finding was upheld by its at-tier contract record (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20428, comment 5868857450). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (read at the objectstack `.objectui-sha` pin `f8a9d0fb0`; not browser-run)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx` (around `:3076-3086`): `CodeWidget` reads its value as `typeof value === 'string' ? value : (value == null ? '' : String(value))`.
- A stored ADR-0089 expression envelope (`{ dialect: 'cel', source: '…' }`) is an object, so the editor shows `[object Object]`. The first edit writes a bare string over the envelope and drops its `meta`.
- `ConditionWidget` in the same file (around `:2647-2649`) was fixed for exactly this failure (objectui#3218), by going through `expressionSource` / `writeExpressionSource`. `inspectors/expression-envelope.ts` states that a persisted artifact carries the envelope.

## Reach (named real producer)

- objectstack's `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema` (`packages/spec/src/shared/expression.zod.ts:263`) transforms every authored predicate string into the envelope, so every stored predicate an admin opens is an envelope.
- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts` authors field-level `visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen`. On `origin/main` the examples author these keys 15 times across 5 files.

## Rows that render through `CodeWidget` over an expression slot (objectstack forms)

- `packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts`: the field rows `visibleWhen`, `readonlyWhen` and `requiredWhen` (`:347-349`), and the formula `expression` row (`:302`).
- `packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts:77` (`condition`).
- The three field-form predicate rows added by objectstack-ai/objectstack#20428, which copy the object designer's rows as the ruling's code/expression class.

## Where the fix lands (for the dispatch to confirm)

`CodeWidget` reads and writes through the shared `expressionSource` / `writeExpressionSource` pair, as `ConditionWidget` already does. One objectui change closes the class for every row above. The pin, which should fail today: render `CodeWidget` with `value = { dialect: 'cel', source: 'x' }` and assert that the editor text is `x`; then an edit round-trips to an envelope.

Dedupe: objectui#9107 (closed; the react enablement keys' envelope flattening) and objectui#3218 (closed; the `ConditionWidget` fix) are the only related hits. None covers `CodeWidget`.

Dedupe words: `CodeWidget expression envelope object Object` · `type code expression row envelope` · `CodeWidget String(value)` · `code widget predicate envelope round-trip`
